fact: On 6 April 2026 the University of Djibouti's Center for Research in Mathematics and Digital Technology (CRMN) and CEALT, with Jamhuuriya University, launched a research project on Somali-language fake news detection and the Somali-Language AI & Innovation Lab (SAIL).
title: Djibouti and Somalia Launch Joint Initiative to Advance AI in the Somali Language
